faqs.heading: Hiring a virtual assistant in *Sydney*
items: Are your virtual assistants based in Sydney?

Our virtual assistants work remotely from the Philippines, while our Australian office is in Chatswood. The Sydney locations on this page identify the businesses we support. See [how our service works](/how-it-works) for the recruitment and onboarding process.
How do I hire a virtual assistant for my Sydney business?

Start by identifying the work you need completed, the experience required, and the hours you need covered. Virtual Office Angels uses these requirements to recruit suitable candidates and support the hiring process. Our Sydney assignments span administration, accounts, marketing and finance.
Can you support our teams in other cities?

Yes. Explore our [Brisbane and Gold Coast](/virtual-assistants-brisbane), and [Melbourne](/virtual-assistants-melbourne) service area pages to learn more about our services. You can also [contact our team](/contact) to discuss further about the needed virtual support across your business.
Can a virtual assistant work alongside my existing Sydney team?

Yes. A virtual assistant can take responsibility for defined remote tasks within your team’s workflow. During the consulting and role-planning stage of our HR-managed virtual support recruitment, we agree on who assigns work, reviews completed tasks, and handles questions that require a manager’s decision.
